subject: SIG packaging: batch manifest + portal routing
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: SIG packaging request and preferred upload formats

Hi Ben —

Thanks for taking this on. Procurement at Acme has a few strict requirements for SIG deliverables and the portal upload. Quick summary:
- We prefer a single ZIP per SIG bundle for our intake system.
- Inside the ZIP we need: per-control PDFs (one file per SIG section), a manifest CSV with filename, control id, page range, SHA256 checksum, and a human-readable index PDF.
- Files must be flattened PDFs (no comments/live links) and named with the pattern ACME_SIG_YYYYMMDD_section#.pdf.
- Upload will be to OneTrust (we can grant upload access) but if you cannot push, we can accept a secure S3 link.

Can you confirm estimated lead time and whether your team can supply both the ZIP and the OneTrust upload? Also attaching our procurement checklist (acme_SIG_requirements_0419.pdf).

Thanks —
Olivia Grant
Senior Contracts Manager
Acme Health
olivia.grant@acmehealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Apr 2026 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG packaging request and preferred upload formats

Olivia —

Appreciate the checklist, that helps. We can produce the deliverable in the requested structure. Proposed approach and ask:

Plan (high level)
- Export SIG answers and evidence as a single PDF export from our SIG tool.
- Run an automated split job to emit per-section PDFs (one per SIG question group), flatten PDFs, and normalize fonts.
- Generate a manifest CSV with these columns: filename, sig_control_id, page_start-page_end, sha256_checksum, source_doc (e.g., SOC2-report.pdf), reviewer_initials.
- Bundle into ACME_SIG_20260427_bundle_v1.zip and upload to OneTrust under the Acme Health workspace. If you prefer S3, we can provide a presigned URL.

Questions for you:
1) Will procurement grant an uploader account for redwood@acmehealth workspace, or should we deliver the ZIP to your secure intake email?
2) Any restrictions on embedded images being OCRed? We usually flatten + OCR to preserve searchability but can skip OCR if required.

Estimated timeline: 48 hours from confirmed upload access, 72 hours if we need to route via secure S3 + procurement ingestion.

I attached a sample manifest template (sample_manifest_v1.csv) and will loop in Marissa for the split/flatten technical details.

Next steps: Marissa — can you confirm the split script and any edge-case notes (e.g., multi-page appendices, stamped PDFs)? Rishi — can you confirm this packaging pattern meets our security policy for external uploads?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG packaging request and preferred upload formats

Ben / Olivia —

Technical notes for the packaging job (runbook):

1) Source export
- Pull full SIG export as single PDF (answers + attachments). File name: redwood_SIG_export_20260425.pdf

2) Split logic
- Use pdfsplit.py to split by top-level control headings. If control spans multiple annex pages, include full page range in manifest.
- Naming: ACME_SIG_20260427_section<NN>_v1.pdf (zero-padded section numbers).

3) Flattening & normalization
- Use qpdf --linearize + ghostscript -dPDFSETTINGS=/screen to flatten and reduce size; then run pdftk to remove annotations.
- For searchability: run OCR (tesseract) into a new layer only if Acme confirms allowance.

4) Manifest generation
- sample_manifest_v1.csv columns: filename,control_id,page_range,sha256,source_doc,notes
- Compute SHA256 after final flattening step. Include page ranges based on the split output.

5) Packaging & checksum
- Create bundle: ACME_SIG_20260427_bundle_v1.zip; include manifest and an index.pdf with one-line summaries.
- Generate bundle-level checksum (sha256_bundle.txt) and include in ZIP.

6) Portal upload
- Preferred: OneTrust workspace upload (requires uploader user). Alternate: AWS presigned S3 link (expiry 7 days).

Edge cases we handle: embedded Excel screenshots (export as separate evidence file), very large appendices (split into appendix_1.pdf ...).

Estimated run time & ownership
- Production run (once access granted): 3-4 hours for full SIG of this size (includes OCR).
- Owner: Marissa (runbook owner), Ben (procurement coordination), Rishi (final sign-off on evidence).

Attachments: pdf_split_script.sh (small helper), exported_SIG_pages_flattened.pdf (example of 2-page sample).

Marissa Cole
Sr. Technical Writer, Developer Experience | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acmehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG packaging request and preferred upload formats

Olivia / Ben —

Thanks for the plan — this packaging approach is acceptable from a security/compliance standpoint with a few addenda:

- Evidence types accepted: flattened PDFs, signed PDFs, exported CSV manifests. No executable attachments inside the ZIP.
- Checksums: SHA256 required at file-level and bundle-level (we'll validate on ingestion).
- PII: ensure any screenshots are redacted. If any evidence contains customer data, flag it in the manifest notes column.
- Transport: OneTrust direct upload preferred. If you must use S3, use presigned link without public ACL and set expiry <= 7 days.

OneTrust upload link for Acme workspace: https://onetrust.example.com/upload/ACME-REQ-789 (requester should receive upload role by procurement).

Ben — once you have upload access, please notify procurement and share the bundle-level sha256 and the hubspot ticket: https://hubspot.example.com/contacts/ACME-12345 so we can close the security review.

If you need a temporary exception (e.g., SFTP), we can approve for this one-off with documented justification.

Rishi Malhotra
Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
